findings.observation: Anderson and Tali portraits, active speaker names, wrapped text and dialogue choices are readable. The councillor portraits remain generic diamonds, explicitly labelled Conseiller turien / Conseillère asari.
The three captured responses retain the demand for evidence; Udina, Anderson and both councillors are also recorded from real visible speaker controls in the run report.

The pre-event intro has no recording detail. The received-proof capture shows the recording details after public acceptance; the actual export records her recruitment. An import toast temporarily overlaps the end of the intro sentence in the before-proof capture. The later evidence capture is unobscured.

Anderson command text, investigation leads, final confirmation and the reloaded three enabled destinations are visible. Existing earlier physical Normandy access remains, so DIA-anderson-transmission is still partial.

limitations: Visual reading at one desktop viewport only; no mobile, physical controller, target FPS or original scene fidelity certification.
No original ME1 transcript or full scene capture comparison was performed.
The native prologue and position transfers are declared fixtures, not traversals played by this collector.
Existing transient save/import toasts overlap portions of some screenshots; no CSS or DOM was changed for capture.

DIA-anderson-avant-eden-prime.basis: Public three tones, all questions, exit, no mutation and final map confirmation; native graph closure.

DIA-premiere-audience.basis: All active speaker labels recorded from public controls and three response captures reviewed.

DIA-tali-preuve.basis: Native pre-event gate, public explicit acceptance and unchanged-reward export, visual received-proof line.

DIA-intronisation.basis: Native three response branches retain the same verdict; public honor and resolve paths plus question path reach the same handoff without new morality/reward until final confirmation.

DIA-anderson-transmission.basis: Command handoff and existing unique reward verified; first physical unlock of Normandy is not implemented because the ship remains accessible earlier.
